title: Insane Man Threatens Girlfriend, Then Attempts To Punch Officer
description:
On May 19th, 2023. An officer responded to an ongoing domestic dispute between a man and his girlfriend. The man was said to have been drinking and started to make threats towards his girlfriend. It was also said that the man was sharpening up a knife for some reason. When officers had a conversation with the man, he kept saying his girlfriend took his I.D and that's why he was aggravated. The man even tried to take a swing at an officer for no reason.  This is footage of the events that followed.

https://www.facebook.com/policewatch101/

police101watch@gmail.com
